title: Towards Optimal Quantum Estimators for State Frame Potential
summary: The state frame potential is a standard diagnostic of how closely a quantum state ensemble approximates Haar randomness. In this work, we study the problem of estimating the state frame potential of order $t$ to within additive error $\varepsilon$ under three progressively weaker access models: (i) query access to a multi-state-preparation oracle, (ii) general sample access, and (iii) single-copy sample access.
